proposal.exec_summary: DataFlow will cut Acme's invoice-matching cycle from 9 days to under 2, recovering ~£40k/yr in finance-team time.
proposal.problem_statement: Acme's finance team spends 9 days a month manually matching POs, GRNs and invoices, per the Head of Finance.
proposal.solution: An automated three-way-match module that flags exceptions and clears clean matches without human touch.
proposal.roi_case: 7 days saved per cycle at the rate quoted in discovery (~£40k/yr); payback inside the first quarter.

available_excerpts.question: How long does invoice matching take?
available_excerpts.answer: About 9 days a month, all manual.

available_excerpts.question: What would that time be worth?
